status: Exterior fixture geometry implemented, exported and inspected in checkpoint 0.8; dimensional and unobserved-face limits retained

observations.subject: Linear lighting at pedestal cornice
observations.finding: Long pale metal housings stand on small dark feet above the cornice, in front of the shaft foot. A narrow longitudinal seam, dark end, joint/collar and support brackets are visible. Both SW and SE housings are resolved in this view.
observations.limits: Do not infer the light manufacturer, lens profile, number of electrical units, exact length or hidden-face arrangements from the bright front surface.

observations.subject: Pyramid and upper shaft
observations.finding: Pyramid edge weathering and shaft mortar beds are visible. No dark horizontal opening is resolved on the broad SW-facing triangle in this view.
observations.limits: An upper dark horizontal slot is visible in other SE photographs; map the face and dates before repeating it on all sides or treating it as a confirmed vent.

observations.subject: Shaft courses
observations.finding: Individual bed heights and vertical bonds are clearly visible over much of the shaft. Current uniform courses / repeated vertical bond pattern should be compared to these originals.
observations.limits: Colour changes alone do not prove mortar joints. Perspective and variable face depth require registration before assigning world heights.

observations.subject: Two barred pyramid openings
observations.finding: SE and NW faces have narrow barred openings just above the shaft-to-pyramid junction. SW appears plain in commons-3563087. NE is unresolved.
observations.limits: Purpose, exact spacing and depths are not established; estimates are documented in fixture calibration.
